stories.title: Il Cremlino dice no all'incontro a Miami "Zelensky venga a Mosca"

en.title: Kremlin rejects Miami meeting, demands Zelensky come to Moscow
en.summary: Zelensky proposed talks with Putin at the December G20 in Miami and requested Patriot systems for air defense, while Ukraine conducted attacks on Russian regions. Germany is investigating a suspected Russian GRU agent in connection with a bombing in Leipzig.

stories.title: Attacco Houthi in Arabia Saudita: presi di mira depositi d'armi e base militare a Sharurah

en.title: Houthi attack targets Saudi Arabia weapons depot and military base in Sharurah
en.summary: Houthi forces attacked military and weapons storage facilities in Saudi Arabia, which had closed its East-West pipeline. Iraq sealed its borders with Iran amid regional tensions.

stories.title: “Gli Houthi possono tagliar fuori Suez danneggiando l’economia globale”

en.title: Houthis could block Suez, damaging global economy
en.summary: An analysis by Yemeni expert Maged Al-Madhaji warns that Houthi threats to shipping routes could force companies to divert vessels, raising costs and impacting energy and trade sectors globally.

stories.title: Svezia, allarme estrema destra. “Possono andare al governo”

en.title: Sweden alarmed by far-right surge ahead of elections
en.summary: Swedish elections today pit left-wing parties against conservatives prepared to form a government with the neo-Nazi-inspired Democrats party.

stories.title: Trump atterra a Dublino e fa scoppiare la polemica. “Vorrei l’Irlanda riunita”

en.title: Trump lands in Dublin and sparks controversy. "I would like a united Ireland"
en.summary: The US president stated that Irish reunification would eventually happen, triggering criticism from Unionists while receiving support from Sinn Féin. The UK government disputed that public consensus exists for a referendum on the matter.

stories.title: Morsa Houthi sul Mar Rosso: preso lo Stretto di Bab el-Mandeb, sale l'allarme per l'economia globale

en.title: Houthi grip on the Red Sea: the Strait of Bab el-Mandeb is taken, alarm rises for global economy
en.summary: Houthi forces have taken control of a crucial global trade chokepoint in the Red Sea. Iranian Revolutionary Guards celebrated the development while Gulf states held emergency meetings in Oman.

stories.title: Houthi, 'colpita una base militare saudita con missili balistici e droni'

en.title: Houthis claim strike on Saudi military base with ballistic missiles and drones
en.summary: Houthi forces reported carrying out a precise attack on a Saudi Arabian military facility using ballistic missiles and unmanned aircraft.

stories.title: Serie A, Atalanta-Cagliari 1-2. La sintesi della partita

en.title: Serie A, Atalanta-Cagliari 1-2. Match summary
en.summary: Cagliari defeated Atalanta 2-1 in a Serie A match, with goals from Mendy and Scamacca, while Maldini scored for Atalanta.

stories.title: Trump a Dublino apre un altro fronte: “Un’Irlanda unita sarebbe fantastica”

en.title: Trump in Dublin opens another front: "A united Ireland would be fantastic"
en.summary: The US president expressed support for Irish reunification, prompting rejection from the UK government over lack of public backing and criticism from British politician Farage, who affirmed Northern Ireland's status within the United Kingdom.

stories.title: Malore per Sofia Goggia durante allenamenti in Argentina, rientra in Italia in anticipo

en.title: Sofia Goggia falls ill during training in Argentina, returns to Italy early
en.summary: Italian skiing champion Sofia Goggia became unwell during training in Argentina and is returning to Italy ahead of schedule, though her condition does not appear serious.

stories.title: Sofia Goggia, malore in Argentina e rientro in Italia: si stava allenando a Ushuaia

en.title: Sofia Goggia, health issue in Argentina and return to Italy: she was training in Ushuaia
en.summary: Italian champion Sofia Goggia experienced a health problem while training in Ushuaia, Argentina, and returned to Italy. She had been in South America since August 23.

stories.title: Sci: accusato malori, Sofia Goggia rientra anticipatamente dall'Argentina

en.title: Skiing: Sofia Goggia returns early from Argentina after health issues
en.summary: Sofia Goggia's training trip to Ushuaia, Argentina ended early due to health problems. She will undergo medical examinations.

stories.title: Stress emergente, l’Aidp in prima linea

en.title: Emerging stress, Aidp in the front line
en.summary: Aidp is addressing the issue of return-to-work stress, which remains under-explored in established workplace practices but is widely felt in companies. The organization has begun developing solutions to tackle this concern.

stories.title: Alberto Fassi: «Per fare impresa, non smettere mai di sognare»

en.title: Alberto Fassi: "To do business, never stop dreaming"
en.summary: Legami founder Alberto Fassi discusses his entrepreneurial vision and two special projects: the Dreamland natural park and the book "We are dreamers."

stories.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: piano governativo a fasi per gestire lo stop all’area a caldo e le ripercussioni occupazionali

en.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: government plan in phases to manage the hot area shutdown and employment repercussions
en.summary: Following a Milan Court of Appeal order issued on September 11, the hot section of the former Ilva steel plant in Taranto must cease operations by end of October, prompting a phased government management plan for the shutdown and its employment consequences.

en.title: Production advancing slowly in Lombardy
en.summary: Lombardy's economy showed industrial production growth of 0.1% on a quarterly basis in the second trimester, marking the sixth consecutive advance in an ongoing recovery.

stories.title: Presentato in Usa supermagnete italiano ad alta temperatura

en.title: Italian high-temperature supermagnent presented in USA
en.summary: An Italian high-technology supermagnent was presented in Pittsburgh by Lucio Rossi, project leader of the National Institute of Nuclear Physics, led by Antonio Zoccoli.
